The ordered tree has the stated exhaustive operation bounds. Its table-wide mean 7 charge additionally uses H1's equal C1 mass per retained entry and first-six prefix retention, not an empirical timing average.
experiments.scope: Binding 13 x 2^19 table, six lanes, first-six retention, selected a0 window and kept CV class at reduced size. Trials 0..3 draw SHAKE first blocks until ((cv0>>24)&63)==12, choose r/ustart and 512 SEL sub-blocks from the seed, build from 2^17 consecutive u and scan 2^17 a0. The combined tag/C1 test, ordered lane tree, postfilters and step3b run on each candidate. Tag claws are compared with an independent retained-entry search and real E16; C1 claws and every postfilter flag are compared with real-word definitions. These sparse trials have about ten claws, so they check semantics rather than rates. Trial 4 is the positive P8 step3b control. Trial 5 exhausts tag classes and 16,128 C1 lane cases. Trial 6 compares 16 bitsliced batches with the scalar predicate and checks the 218-operation program bound. Trial 7 samples window rates on 2^15 C1/C2 draws. Trial 8 samples class F7 rates on 2^15 draws with 16 cv0 values per group. Trial 9 invokes the actual walk on all 63 nonempty guard masks, checking order, additive charges 6,6,6,8,8,8 and maximum 18 per read. Trial 10 recomputes the full integer ledger with mean 7, worst 18 and one-time 2^24 initialization. Trials 11..255 return no pair. Numeric observations are participant reports. The base's 24 full native 14-vs-filtered-15 comparisons and memory receipts and the exact 13-column census are separately scoped in Appendix U. Native 15-column/reference/bounded comparisons are evidence-only, never procedure phases or procedure inputs; only the base's physical 14-column production runs witness the non-table online memory allowance.
